mapper.select: SELECT id,owner_principal_id,purpose,object_key,status,mime,size_bytes,width,height,upload_expires_at,cleanup_after,checksum FROM media_assets WHERE id=#{id} AND owner_principal_id=#{owner} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT id FROM principals WHERE account_id=#{accountId} AND kind='account'
SELECT kind,object_key,size_bytes,width,height FROM media_variants WHERE media_id=#{mediaId}
mapper.update: UPDATE media_assets SET status='uploaded',mime=#{mime},size_bytes=#{size},object_key=#{objectKey},checksum=#{checksum},updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND owner_principal_id=#{owner} AND status='initiated' AND checksum=#{tokenDigest} AND upload_expires_at>#{now}
UPDATE media_assets SET status='processing',updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND owner_principal_id=#{owner} AND status='uploaded'

UPDATE media_assets SET status='approved',mime=#{mime},size_bytes=#{size},width=#{width},height=#{height},checksum=#{checksum},cleanup_after=NULL,updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND owner_principal_id=#{owner} AND status='processing'

UPDATE media_assets SET status='deleted',deleted_at=#{now},updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND owner_principal_id=#{owner} AND status IN ('initiated','uploaded','processing','approved','rejected') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM post_media WHERE media_id=#{id}) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM comment_media WHERE media_id=#{id})
